title: Last Signal
synopsis: A lone station engineer receives a message from a ship that was lost a century ago.

chapters.title: Static
chapters.content:
Station Kepler had been silent for eleven months when the receiver woke up.

Orion Vale pressed the headset to his ear. Under the static, a voice counted backwards from ten.

The call sign belonged to the Meridian, a ship declared lost one hundred years ago.

chapters.title: Coordinates
chapters.content:
The voice stopped at one, and the screen filled with coordinates.

They pointed at empty space only six light-minutes away. Orion checked the numbers twice, then began warming the engines.
